_about: Hand-written inputs for the site: card art per player (The Show card uuid), display names, and the stat line and quote featured beside each major award. The count does not depend on this file.

quote.text: I have been told for years that a pitcher cannot be the MVP, usually by people who have never watched one decide a ballgame by himself.
quote.outlet: The Mission Bay Ledger-Dispatch · San Diego chapter

quote.text: Wins, ERA, strikeouts - that is the old pitching Triple Crown, shared wins column and all, and it makes this the easiest box I ticked.
quote.outlet: The Birdtown Morning Ledger · Birds beat

quote.text: That is a rookie pitching like the fourth-best arm in the league because he was.
TallThibaut48 gets second because there are two managers, and because he did win that first series, which I enjoyed enormously for about two days.
quote.outlet: The Worm County Ledger-Dispatch · Worms beat

quote.text: Yes, there is a blown save on the ledger and one unearned run, and I grumbled about it for a full minute before remembering that 0.00 is 0.00.
Yes, there is a blown save on his card, and I grumbled about it, but any closer who says he never blew one is lying or never got the ball.
Add 15 steals, 6 doubles, and just 2 strikeouts in 76 plate appearances, and you have a card that went from passenger to problem.
I will grumble that he drew exactly one walk in 112 trips, but when you get on base that often I will forgive how you did it.
quote.outlet: Hall of Fame leadoff man · expert panel

stats: home runs, most in the league

quote.text: I have my private grumbles about a job where a man never needs a glove, but if the job exists, the fellow who hits 10 homers at it gets the award.
quote.outlet: The Birdtown Morning Ledger · Birds beat

quote.text: 111 outs is the most anybody recorded, 82 of them on the ground, with a single error in 29 games at second; I looked for a reason to drop him and the dossier did not give me one.
